text:
marta nguyen: Heads-up from vendor PMs: MI300 firmware batch 7 and Gaudi driver 2.3 have overlapping test windows. Partners want a clear staggered embargo so marketplace images and SI certs don't collide.
lucas wang: Agree. Recommend we stagger by region: NA -> EU (48h lag) -> APAC (extra 5 business days for firmware certs). APAC explicitly asked for kernel module sign-off.
priya sen: @lucas noted. For SIs we should provide two image tracks: `mi300-stable` and `mi300-canary`. SIs will need signed images for on-prem. We'll provide `sha256` checksums and signed manifest.
```
# sample manifest verification
curl -sSf https://cdn.redwood/mi300/manifest.json | jq -r .digest | sha256sum -c -
```
tom crossing: Ops can carve out a staging rack for SI dryruns. Suggest 40 MI300 nodes and 30 Gaudi nodes for the week of verification. Need partner names to grant temporary network ACLs.
legal-eu-bot: EU legal requires a 72h pre-embargo review on any partner-facing PRs. Please tag `legal-eu` on the PRs and include risk checklist.
priya sen: Adding runbook checklist items: kernel version, nfs mount options, runtime ldflags for kernel moduless, and example systemd unit. I'll post the 1-pager tonight.
lucas wang: We should include fallback routing policy in case MI300 batch has thermal incidents: auto-route inference to h100-compatible variants or Gaudi if within perf SLAs. config example below: 
```json
{"routing": {"primary": "mi300-v2", "fallbacks": ["h100-compat", "gaudi-lt"], "threshold_pct": 12}}
```
marta nguyen: Nice. Partners also want clear marketplace SKU semantics so SIs can validate—separate SKU for on-prem signed image vs marketplace-hosted. Priya can you own SKU naming?
priya sen: I'll propose SKU names: `MI300-v2-market`, `MI300-v2-signed-onprem`, `Gaudi-2.3-market`, `Gaudi-2.3-signed-onprem`. Will add mapping to the shared sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/partner-skus (internal).
tom crossing: Ops action: reserve staging racks + open temporary peering for partner IPs. I'll put numbers and CIDR ranges in the ticket.
marta nguyen: Proposed timeline (high level):
- Day -10: share compatibility matrix + signed image process
- Day -7: SI invites + staging ACLs configured
- Day -5 to -1: SI dryruns (regionally phased)
- Day 0: embargo notify (48-72h to press), marketplace listings go live in NA
- Day +3: EU lift if legal clears; APAC rollout Day +10 after firmware cert

lucas wang: Please add telemetry hooks (thermal alerts, kernel oops) to the canary dashboards. We'll need 15m granularity for first 72h.
priya sen: Will include sample `dmesg` and `journald` filters in the runbook and a curl example for healthz: 
```
curl -fS https://staging.redwood/api/v1/healthz | jq .
```
partners-bot: Calendar event created: "MI300/Gaudi staging + SI dryruns" on 2026-05-04 08:00 UTC. Invitees: partnerships, eng-runtime, ops, legal-eu
marta nguyen: Assignments: @priya — SKU naming + runbook, @tom — staging racks + peering, @lucas — routing policy + telemetry. Please update by EOD Friday.
lucas wang: I'll post routing policy PR with exact variant names.
priya sen: Draft runbook link: https://docs.internal/redwood/mi300-gaudi-runbook (will be private until approved)
tom crossing: Reserving racks now, will confirm counts in 2h.
marta nguyen: Thanks team. We'll sync with vendor PMs after legal slot is confirmed. :raised_hands:
